abilities.desc_en: Power Burn

abilities.desc_zh: 远程增益
abilities.desc_en: Ranged Buff

abilities.desc_zh: 在仪表板上：
abilities.desc_en: On Dash Back:

abilities.title_en: Prowl tries to Suppress the opponent. While tension is building up, Prowl prepares for the inevitable fight by charging a Melee Buff every {{var_1}} for a maximum of 10 stacks.
abilities.desc_zh: 警车试图压制对手。当紧张局势加剧时，警车为不可避免的战斗做好准备，每 {{var_1}} 充能一个近战增益，最多叠加 10 层。
abilities.desc_en: Prowl tries to Suppress the opponent. While tension is building up, Prowl prepares for the inevitable fight by charging a Melee Buff every {{var_1}} for a maximum of 10 stacks.

abilities.title_en: When Prowl is struck or hits towards the opponent, each Melee Buff increases damage by {{var_2}} for {{var_3}}.
abilities.desc_zh: 当警车被击中或击中对手时，每个近战增益都会为 {{var_3}} 增加 {{var_2}} 伤害。
abilities.desc_en: When Prowl is struck or hits towards the opponent, each Melee Buff increases damage by {{var_2}} for {{var_3}}.

abilities.title_en: {{var_4}} chance to automatically Evade the next incoming attack. This interrupts the charging of Melee Buffs.
abilities.desc_zh: {{var_4}} 有机会自动躲避下一次攻击。这会中断近战增益的充电。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_4}} chance to automatically Evade the next incoming attack. This interrupts the charging of Melee Buffs.

abilities.desc_zh: 远程攻击：
abilities.desc_en: Ranged Attacks:

abilities.title_en: {{var_5}} chance to Stun opponents for {{var_6}} on the first Ranged hit of a combo. (Unlisted)
abilities.desc_zh: 在连击的第一次远程攻击中，有 {{var_5}} 机会击晕对手，获得 {{var_6}}。 （未列出）
abilities.desc_en: {{var_5}} chance to Stun opponents for {{var_6}} on the first Ranged hit of a combo. (Unlisted)

abilities.title_en: +{{var_7}} chance if Prowl is charging his Melee Buffs. (Unlisted)
abilities.desc_zh: 如果警车正在为其近战增益蓄力，则 +{{var_7}} 几率。 （未列出）
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_7}} chance if Prowl is charging his Melee Buffs. (Unlisted)

abilities.desc_zh:
在为他的近战增益充电后，警车会根据他激活的近战增益数量获得能量激增。

被动：在为近战增益充电后，警车会为每个激活的近战增益获得 {{var_8}} 能量。

每级 +{{var_9}}。
abilities.desc_en:
Good Cop
After charging his Melee Buffs, Prowl gets a surge of Power based on how many Melee Buffs he activated.
Passive: After charging his Melee Buffs, Prowl gets {{var_8}} Power for each Melee Buff activated.
+{{var_9}} per level.

abilities.desc_zh: 他的保险丝短路了，他们也短路了。
abilities.desc_en: Short Circuit - His short fuse and their short circuit.

abilities.desc_zh: {{var_10}} 机会进行能量燃烧，最多消耗目标最大能量 {{var_11}}。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_10}} chance to Power Burn, consuming up to {{var_11}} of the target’s max Power.

abilities.desc_zh: 如果对手由于此能量燃烧而达到零能量，则在剩余的战斗中，其能量获取增益的强度将减少 {{var_12}}。
abilities.desc_en: If the opponent reaches zero Power as a result of this Power Burn, the strength of their Power Gain Buffs is reduced by {{var_12}} for the rest of the fight.
{{var_17}}~{{var_18}} Armor.

abilities.desc_zh: {{var_19}}~{{var_20}} 汽车人装甲。 {{var_21}}~{{var_22}} 在单人任务中对汽车人的近战伤害。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_19}}~{{var_20}} Armor for Autobots. {{var_21}}~{{var_22}} Melee Damage for Autobots in Solo Missions.
{{var_23}}~{{var_24}} Armor.

abilities.desc_zh: {{var_25}}~{{var_26}} 使用重击时 {{var_27}} 的攻击增益。堆叠这些增益会刷新整个堆叠的持续时间。
abilities.desc_en: {{var_25}}~{{var_26}} Attack Buff for {{var_27}} when using a Heavy Attack. Stacking those buffs refreshes the duration of the entire stack.
{{var_28}}~{{var_29}} Attack Rating.
{{var_30}}~{{var_31}} Armor.

abilities.desc_zh: 大黄蜂的重击为每个活着的团队成员获得 {{var_32}}~{{var_33}} 攻击增益。
abilities.desc_en: Bumblebee's Heavy Attacks gain a {{var_32}}~{{var_33}} Attack Buff for each alive team member.

abilities.desc_zh: 擎天柱获得 {{var_34}}~{{var_35}} 攻击力和装甲值，他的副官获得独特的能力。
abilities.desc_en: Optimus gains {{var_34}}~{{var_35}} Attack and Armor and his lieutenants gain unique abilities.

abilities.desc_zh: 如果警车将对手的力量消耗至最大力量的 {{var_36}}，他有 {{var_37}}~{{var_38}} 的机会击晕对手 {{var_39}}。
abilities.desc_en: If Prowl Drains the opponent’s Power to {{var_36}} of their Max Power, he has a {{var_37}}~{{var_38}} chance to Stun the opponent for {{var_39}}.
